description:
Make `doc assets list --rescan` check the issue's lease inside its publishing session, as every other user-requested issue write does.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs` ~1030: the rescan publishes an issue update (`documents.assets`) through `with_mutation_session` without the lease check, and `crates/jit/src/cli.rs` ~3102 (`AssetCommands::coordinates_claims_first`) classifies it repository-first, so in strict mode it can overwrite another agent's leased issue.
- Epic `b697a3f7` holistic-review (2026-11-09), finding 1. Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): in scope; a covering exemption must already be recorded, none is created here.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-04 (every issue mutation checks leases inside its publishing session against captured claims evidence, through one check).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `doc assets list --rescan` takes the claims guard first and checks the issue's lease inside its publishing session through the shared lease check; a strict-mode rescan of an issue leased by another agent is refused and writes nothing.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every other `with_mutation_session` caller that writes an existing issue record either goes through the shared lease check or is covered by an exemption already recorded (the plan's `lease-checked-writes` entry or an existing ruling); the worker's report lists each caller with its check or the cited exemption, and a caller with neither gets the check.
- [hard] REQ-03: One test shows the strict-mode refusal for the rescan, reusing the existing lease-check test fixtures; no per-command lease test is added beyond it.


- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): claim synchronization (`claim.rs` `synchronize_claim_repository_state`) is an issue mutation under epic REQ-04 and checks the lease in its publishing session through the shared `refuse_foreign_leases_held`, counting the claimer's own fresh lease as non-foreign; the coordinator grant precedes capture, so a force-evicted and re-granted lease between them is refused.

- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09), revised: REQ-04's single lease check is met for claim synchronization by acquisition under the claims lock that also spans the publish (`storage/claim_coordinator.rs` ~687–764); adding `refuse_foreign_leases_held` there would be unreachable. A one-line comment at the repository sync states the invariant.
title: Asset rescans check the issue's lease in session
